command:
cd /tmp/ch1-ref/os && ELF=target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os && gdb -nx -q -batch "$ELF" \
 -ex 'set architecture riscv:rv64' \
 -ex 'disassemble /r os::clear_bss::{closure#0}' \
 -ex 'disassemble /r os::sbi::console_putchar' \
 -ex 'disassemble /r os::board::{impl#1}::exit' \
 -ex 'x/4i _start' 2>&1 | sed -n '1,140p'
